raw_glosses: (British, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada) An alcoholic, often sparkling (carbonated) beverage made from fermented apples.
glosses: An alcoholic, often sparkling (carbonated) beverage made from fermented apples.

examples.text: The procedures for cyser are identical to cider with a notable exception: honey is a much more complex sugar than cane or corn sugars, meaning honey takes a long time to clear and an even longer time (at least six months) to ferment out[…]

glosses: This or any similar alcoholic drink made from similar fruit, such as pears.

examples.text: I picked up a jug of cider for the kids.

raw_glosses: (US, Canada) A non-alcoholic uncarbonated beverage consisting of the juice of early-harvest apples, usually unfiltered and still containing pulp; without pulp such a beverage is called apple juice.
glosses: A non-alcoholic uncarbonated beverage consisting of the juice of early-harvest apples, usually unfiltered and still containing pulp; without pulp such a beverage is called apple juice.

raw_glosses: (Australia) A non-alcoholic carbonated beverage made from apples or pears.
glosses: A non-alcoholic carbonated beverage made from apples or pears.

raw_glosses: (Japan, South Korea) A non-alcoholic, lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage.
glosses: A non-alcoholic, lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage.

raw_glosses: (countable) A cup, glass, or serving of any of these beverages.
glosses: A cup, glass, or serving of any of these beverages.
